before.body: Courtyard by Marriott is a Marriott select-service brand oriented to business and bleisure demand within Marriott International. For owners, the affiliation case is business demand capture, select-service operations, renovation or conversion diligence, and Marriott Bonvoy platform participation. It should be evaluated on its own guest promise and operating implications, not as a generic parent-brand substitute or an interchangeable peer among AC Hotels by Marriott, Moxy Hotels, City Express by Marriott, Fairfield by Marriott.

after.title: Commercial Differentiator
after.body: Versus hard limited-service boxes, Courtyard sells a fuller select-service stack; versus lifestyle select-service (Aloft/AC), it prioritizes reliability and corporate utility over design intensity.

after.title: Commercial Engine
after.body: Courtyard by Marriott commercial distribution rides Marriott Bonvoy direct channels, GDS, OTAs, and parent sales systems. Upper midscale select-service: reliable rooms, functional public space, and Marriott Bonvoy distribution for corporate and leisure transient demand. Owners should underwrite channel mix and loyalty contribution for this asset—not corporate averages alone.
